Anuto TD | Open source tower defense game for Android

I'm a sucker for tower defense games and was really excited to see one pop up on the F-Droid repo. Played it for an hour, it's pretty good. My max score is around 32k. I'd be interested in hearing any strategies others have. I put the grenade guns near the start with the things that slow down enemies to maximize splash damage. Lasers at the ends of straightaways so they hit things in a straight line. Machine guns at the end. The pentagon mobs don't seem to be hurt much by grenade splash damage. The upgrades are a little confusing. The grenade gun seems to turn into a landmine launcher type weapon where it shoots a nade at the enemy but it won't go off until another mob walks over it. The slowing gun too changes from a AOE to a direct attack. But then level 3 slow gun sucks up enemies like a vacuum which is neat.

I've gotten to level 41. Level 40 is all stars that heal every few seconds. Even worse they heal each other in close proximity. It's very hard to kill them.

So far my strategy has been to put grenade/landmine launchers at the start set to target strongest, machine guns in the middle targeting weakest and lasers at the end targeting first. Sometimes I'll put level 3 lasers at straightaways to hit multiple mobs at once. I realized the level 3 slow vacuum things actually teleport mobs back to the start (or rather a set distance backwards depending on upgrades), so they're only useful at the end. They also tend to stop sucking up mobs after a certain point, not sure if it's a bug or intended but I've had to quickly destroy and recreate them at times. Haven't quite found a use for level 2 slow guns. Level 3 grenade gun turns into a rocket launcher that does like 50k damage fully upgraded. Good for killing the star things on level 40.

I can't seem to beat level 41. Someone posted on the repo that level 57 is impossible so I have a ways to go.
